# Cardtly

> Cardtly is a digital business card platform built in South Africa. It lets professionals and teams create a digital business card and share it instantly by NFC tap, QR code, or link - no app required for the person receiving it. There is a free-forever plan; Pro is R65/month (South African rand). Live at https://cardtly.com.

## What Cardtly is

A digital business card is an online profile that replaces a paper business card. It holds your name, role, company, contact details, links, and photo on a single page with its own URL. Cardtly cards are shared three ways: an NFC tap (hold the card or phone to another phone), a QR code scan, or a plain link sent over WhatsApp, email, or SMS. The recipient can save the details straight to their phone contacts. Because the card is a live web page, the owner can update it anytime and everyone who has the link sees the latest version.

## Key facts

- Company: Cardtly, based in South Africa, available worldwide.
- Free plan: a digital business card with a public URL, QR code, and contact-save (vCard), free forever, no credit card.
- Pro plan: R65/month in South African rand (ZAR), billed via Paystack. International cards accepted; the bank converts at checkout. Roughly USD 3.50/month equivalent.
- NFC card: an optional physical tap-to-share card, R150 once-off plus R100 shipping in South Africa.
- Teams: branded cards for whole teams with locked company branding, per-member editing, and one admin dashboard. Priced per seat (R65/seat/month), 5-50 seats.
- Android app available on Google Play (com.cardtly.app). iOS coming.

## Main features

- NFC tap-to-share, QR code, and link sharing from one card.
- 12 card templates, fully customisable: accent colours (any hex), fonts, logo, light/dark mode, per-text colours and sizes, custom backgrounds.
- Photo galleries, custom links, WhatsApp, social profiles, certifications, and an AI-written bio.
- Built-in analytics: track views, clicks, and contact saves per card.
- Lead capture and a built-in contacts CRM - visitors share their details and every lead lands in the owner's dashboard.
- Book-a-meeting button: visitors request a meeting time directly from the card; the owner is emailed and the requester is saved to contacts.
- Custom questionnaire (optional add-on): the card owner builds up to five of their own questions and the answers save with each lead.
- Reciprocal contact exchange (optional add-on): after a visitor saves the owner's details, they are prompted to share theirs back.
- Paper business card scanner (Pro): photograph someone else's paper card and AI extracts their details to save to contacts or the phone.
- WhatsApp follow-up: every captured lead has a one-tap WhatsApp button so the owner can reply instantly.
- Contact management: edit, delete or organise any lead, and save any contact straight to the phone address book, or download a vCard.
- One-click Excel export: download all contacts as a colour-branded spreadsheet (names, emails, companies, sources and questionnaire answers).
- Weekly performance digest: an automatic Monday email summarising the past 7 days of card views and new leads.
- Add your card to Google Wallet.
- Email signature generator and branded virtual backgrounds for Zoom and Teams.

## Common questions

- What is a digital business card? An online profile that replaces a paper card, shared by NFC tap, QR code, or link, with details the recipient can save to their phone.
- How much does Cardtly cost? Free forever for the core card. Pro is R65/month. A physical NFC card is R150 once-off plus R100 shipping in South Africa.
- Do I need an NFC card? No. The QR code and link work on the free plan with nothing physical.
- Can teams use it? Yes. Cardtly Teams gives every member a branded card under locked company branding, managed from one admin dashboard.
- Can I scan paper business cards? Yes, on Pro: photograph a paper card and AI reads it into a saved contact.
